summary: Traced where ReadIndex confirmation support is filtered by current membership, closing the witness variant of the removed-voter quorum suspicion. Added three source ranges and a behavior entry: hint-carrying heartbeats go only to current voting members (observers get a zero context, witnesses are not addressed), and a HeartbeatResp is admitted through lw, which resolves the sender against the current remotes, observers and witnesses maps and drops it when absent, after which readIndex.confirm counts the admitted sender without a further role check. So the protection is the send-side voter filter plus admission-time role lookup; a witness cannot occupy a voter acknowledgement seat, and a node that left the voter set is dropped at admission. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with three source creates and one knowledge create. No new execution was run this turn.
